description: Dashboard showing Prometheus Alertmanager metrics for observing status of the cluster and possible debbuging.

panels.title: Number of instances
panels.description: Number of Alertmanager instances exporting metrics right now.

panels.title: Instance versions and up time
panels.description: Version, uptime and configuration reload status per Alertmanager instance.
Largest gossip cluster among the selected Alertmanagers (peers per cluster). Each environment runs its own single-replica Alertmanager, so 1 is normal.
panels.title: Cluster size

panels.description: Alerts currently active (not silenced/inhibited), summed over the selected Alertmanagers. There is one independent Alertmanager per environment, so they are summed, not deduplicated.
panels.title: Number of active alerts

panels.description: Alerts currently suppressed by a silence or inhibition rule, summed over the selected Alertmanagers (one independent Alertmanager per environment).
panels.title: Number of suppressed alerts

panels.description: Silences currently active, summed over the selected Alertmanagers (one independent Alertmanager per environment).
panels.title: Number of active silences
Notifications sent from $instance
panels.description: Notification attempts per integration per interval (alertmanager_notifications_total counts every attempt, including failed ones); failed attempts are drawn below zero. Failed equal to attempted means every notification of that integration fails. Integrations with no attempts are hidden.

panels.title: Notification durations per integration on $instance
panels.description: Average notification delivery latency per integration (sum/count), overall and for the slowest Alertmanager. Percentiles are not shown: the histogram's smallest bucket is 1s (buckets 1/5/10/15/20s) and real latencies are ~20-150ms, so p90/p99 would only interpolate to 0.9s/0.99s.

panels.title: Active alerts in $instance
panels.description: Alerts held by Alertmanager, by state (active / suppressed / unprocessed), stacked and summed over the selected Alertmanagers.

panels.title: Received alerts by status for $instance
panels.description: Alerts received from vmalert per interval, by status (firing / resolved).

panels.title: Clusterhealth score for $instance
panels.description: Gossip cluster health score; 0 is healthy, higher means peers are failing to communicate.

panels.title: Cluster members count on $instance
panels.description: Gossip cluster members and failed peers.

panels.title: Cluster peers left/joined on $instance
panels.description: Peers that left or joined the gossip cluster per interval.

panels.title: Cluster reconnections on $instance
panels.description: Gossip reconnection attempts and failures per interval.

panels.title: Cluster messages count on $instance
panels.description: Gossip messages sent and received per interval, by message type.

panels.title: Cluster messages size on $instance
panels.description: Bytes of gossip messages sent and received per interval, by message type.

panels.title: Cluster messages queue on $instance
panels.description: Gossip messages pruned per interval and messages currently queued.

panels.title: Count of oversized gossip messages on $instance
panels.description: Oversized gossip messages sent, dropped and their totals per interval.

panels.title: Duration of oversized gossip messages on $instance
panels.description: Maximum time to send an oversized gossip message; empty when no oversized messages were sent (normal).

panels.title: Number of  propagated gossip messages on $instance
panels.description: Silence and notification-log gossip messages propagated per interval.

panels.title: Nf log queries count for $instance
panels.description: Notification-log queries and query errors per interval.

panels.title: Nf log query duration for $instance
panels.description: Maximum notification-log query duration.

panels.title: Nf log snapshot size for $instance
panels.description: Size of the notification-log snapshot on disk.

panels.title: Nf log snapshot duration for $instance
panels.description: Average duration of a notification-log snapshot (30m window).

panels.title: Nf log GC duration for $instance
panels.description: Average duration of notification-log garbage collection (30m window).

panels.title: Silences count by state on $instance
panels.description: Silences by state (active / pending / expired).

panels.title: Silences query count on $instance
panels.description: Silence queries and query errors per interval.

panels.title: Silences query duration on $instance
panels.description: Maximum silence query duration.

panels.title: Silences snapshot size on $instance
panels.description: Size of the silences snapshot on disk.

panels.title: Silences snapshot duration on $instance
panels.description: Average duration of a silences snapshot (30m window).

panels.title: Silences GC duraton on $instance
panels.description: Average duration of silences garbage collection (30m window).

panels.title: CPU usage/s for $instance

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu", container="alertmanager"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(alertmanager_build_info{instance=~"$instance"}, "namespace", "$1", "kubernetes_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "kubernetes_pod_name", "(.*)"))

panels.description: CPU cores used by the Alertmanager process, with the alertmanager container's CPU limit when one is set (none are set today, so no limit line).

panels.title: Memory usage for $instance

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", container="alertmanager"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (label_replace(label_replace(alertmanager_build_info{instance=~"$instance"}, "namespace", "$1", "kubernetes_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "kubernetes_pod_name", "(.*)"))

panels.description: Resident memory of the Alertmanager process, with the alertmanager container's memory limit when one is set (none are set today, so no limit line).

title: Alertmanager
